caption: A fresh, sharply rimmed crater occupies the right-central part of the scene, superposed on a more densely cratered, relatively uniform surrounding surface. The continuous rim and deep interior shadow suggest relatively steep inner walls compared with the gentler relief of the adjacent terrain. The subdued texture and lack of prominent structural lineations in the surrounding area may reflect mechanically coherent material under thin regolith cover, consistent with relatively uniform subsurface density. The crisp superposition relations indicate that the central crater is among the youngest features in the frame.
